name: lotoce-quant-intelligence-platform
description: LotoCE Quant Intelligence Platform - Fases 1-3 (banco, importacao Excel, colagem manual)

scripts.migrate: node -e "require('fs').readFile('schema.sql','utf8',(e,sql)=>{if(e)throw e; const {Pool}=require('pg'); const p=new Pool({connectionString:process.env.DATABASE_URL, ssl:{rejectUnauthorized:false}}); p.query(sql).then(()=>{console.log('Schema aplicado com sucesso.'); p.end();}).catch(err=>{console.error(err); process.exit(1);});})"
